perf_tuning_notes: Region choice: us-east-1 reduced client RTT in our tests (p50 ~120-160ms) vs us-west-2 (~200-300ms) for their EU/NA user mix -> recommend us-east-1 as primary for now
Timeouts: recommend soft client timeout 8-12s for short chat turns; for long generation paths set server-side timeout 30s and use streaming to deliver tokens as they generate
Prompt length guidance: truncate long user history aggressively; use condensed system prompts and store embeddings for long-term context retrieval instead of full concatenation
Streaming: enable streaming on client to improve perceived latency (first-byte emitted in <150ms for short responses in us-east-1 test)
Batching/caching: enable prefix/KV cache for repeated KB queries; configure small batching window (5-10ms) to balance throughput vs latency
Retry/fallback: add quick lightweight fallback to cached response for p95 tail mitigation during spikes
Model selection: use smaller generation models for routine replies and promote higher-quality model for escalations
Telemetry: instrument per-route p50/p95, token counts, client timeout events; share dashboard link after tuning call
